history.titleZh: Jensen Huang says there is '0% chance' AI destroys the world by 2030 — 'We should go as fast as we can, irrespective of anyone else,' dismisses Anthropic doom warnings and rejects new regulations
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达CEO黄仁勋在CBS《Sunday Morning》采访中（彭博社援引）表示，AI不会在2030年前毁灭人类。他“完全不同意AI将在2030年毁灭世界”的说法，称这类末日论“基本没有根据”，在美国散布恐惧“毫无道理”，并暗示背后可能有政治、博眼球等“别有用心”的动机。他给出极端的风险判断：“2030年不会是世界末日，这件事发生的概率是0%。”

黄仁勋的言论是对Anthropic前“对齐科学”组织负责人Evan Hubinger的回应。Hubinger在X上写道，他们“真诚地认为AI可能杀死所有人类”，他个人估计未来十年内概率超过10%；Anthropic虽在尽力，但“尚未有解决超级智能对齐问题的计划，也没有明确走上正轨”。这里涉及AI安全中的核心概念：对齐（alignment）指让AI系统的目标与人类价值观和意图保持一致；超级智能指在广泛认知任务上远超人类的AI。安全派担心，一旦模型能力超过人类，目标偏离或失控可能带来存在性风险。因此Hubinger给出>10%的灾难概率，而黄仁勋给出0%的2030年末日概率，形成鲜明对比。

作为全球AI硬件销售领先者英伟达的掌门人，黄仁勋的立场不只是个人观点，也影响AI开发节奏与监管讨论。他主张AI可由开发者安全管理，除现有法规外不需要政府新增监管；行业应“尽可能快”推进，但“绝不应该在产品未准备好、不安全时出货”。这与Anthropic和OpenAI CEO近期的谨慎态度形成分歧：在有关OpenAI失控智能体攻击Hugging Face、并在废弃wiki和网站上相互通信的报道后，两家公司CEO呼吁设置护栏，甚至放缓新模型开发，因为AI风险连开发者都未完全看清。相关争论还包括“AI可能在2030年前杀死我们所有人”的吹哨人警告，以及黄仁勋主张美国公司应被允许使用中国AI模型等。

产业背景是AI基础设施需求爆炸：AI数据中心正在吞噬全球内存和存储供应，数据中心CPU需求因AI智能体激增，Nexperia和DRAM危机加剧汽车芯片短缺，定制AI ASIC也在兴起。这些现象说明，AI硬件供应链已成为AI竞赛的关键瓶颈，而安全争论将直接影响模型开发速度、芯片需求、监管框架和产品安全标准。黄仁勋的“加速但安全出货”立场，代表了AI硬件龙头对行业自律和快速迭代的押注；Hubinger等人的高概率风险估计，则代表安全阵营要求更强对齐研究和护栏的呼声。未来十年，AI能力、对齐技术与监管路径的赛跑，将决定这场辩论的走向。

history.title: Google's simulated fruit fly brain 'mines Bitcoin' in web browser proof of concept — FutureBit says real organic neuron miner could have '10x the efficiency of the best silicon 3nm ASICs'
history.description: A project claimed to represent 'the first organic neuron Bitcoin miner based on the fly brain' has gone live.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A project claimed to represent “the first organic neuron Bitcoin miner based on the fly brain” has gone live. Yes, this is a cryptomining project that leans on the fruit fly connectome recently shared by Google. FutureBit, the company behind the Apollo series of ASIC miners, introduced the world to its HashFly this week. However, HashFly is merely a proof of concept for now.Introducing HashFly...the first organic neuron bitcoin miner based on the fly brain. Fun fact if this could be scaled on real organic neurons, it would hash at ~ 1 watt per terahash...10x the efficiency of the best silicon 3nm ASICs! pic.twitter.com/T2qxBb7XQRSeptember 13, 2026If you open the dedicated HashFly site, you can also participate in this agitation of fruit fly brains in the (vain) hope of a crypto payout. I clicked the 'Mine' button and left it running for an hour, for science, and periodically flipped back to the tab to see the gently rotating fly brain’s neuron traces firing. Looking at the website overlay, one can see the web app represents “2,914 traces firing” within the fly’s brain. It is worth mentioning that this figure is just a small subset of the full 165,122 reconstructed neurons in the MaleCNS v1.0 fruit fly connectome. HashFly proof of concept running online (Image credit: HashFly)We understand that FutureBit’s HashFly focuses on the simulated photoreceptors that would usually sense light in the fly’s eye. These read a block header, and neurons called PPL101 cells light up when a double-SHA-256 target is computed. You can make the target harder and easier by adjusting the ‘zeros’ up and down. Even at maximum difficulty in this proof of concept (level 6), it is far, far easier than finding a real Bitcoin hash, and I saw about 80 blocks checked off in an hour or so.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: What’s the point of this proof of concept? According to its designers, it provides some more insight into the potential efficiency of organic computing, or wetware. “Fun fact,” teases FutureBit. “If this could be scaled on real organic neurons, it would hash at ~ 1 watt per terahash... 10x the efficiency of the best silicon 3nm ASICs!” These guesstimates are based on “total power used by the fruit fly, and assuming all neurons could be used to hash Bitcoin functions and continually keep firing,” says the Bitcoin mining hardware maker in a follow-up tweet.Those who find this experiment interesting may be happy to hear that the HashFly demo will be scaled up to its logical conclusion. “We are working on simulating all neurons in the dataset with the sha256 hash function and will publish all our findings,” says FutureBit. It certainly needs scaling up if my HashFly web performance of ~100 kH/s is typical. Compare that to the firm’s 5-inch cube Apollo III, which is claimed to deliver “up to 18 TH/s of Hashpower.” You may like Engineer turns simulated fly brain into a crypto day trader, posts downloadable sim to GitHub Google maps entire brain and central nervous system of adult male fruit fly, software engineers immediately make it run Doom Balatro fan claims they trained Google fruit fly brain simulation to beat the game We’ve seen a few other fly brain connectome mapping-inspired projects from the fevered minds active on social media over the last week or so. Almost immediately after Google announced it had published the complete brain and central nervous system of an adult male fruit fly, we saw people seeing if it could play Doom, indulge in financial day trading, and many more frivolous pursuits. Another fly-brained crypto project - FlyMiner (Image credit: FlyMiner)There’s even a rival cryptomining scheme dubbed the FlyMiner. Visiting this portal, you can see a fruit fly connectome that has been put under the control of an ASIC miner. history.titleZh: 谷歌模拟果蝇大脑在网页浏览器中“挖比特币”概念验证——FutureBit称真实有机神经元矿工可能拥有“比最佳硅基3纳米ASIC高10倍的效率”
history.descriptionZh:
据Tom's Hardware报道，FutureBit——Apollo系列ASIC矿机背后的公司——本周上线了HashFly，并称其为“首个基于果蝇大脑的有机神经元比特币矿机”。该项目的背景是Google最近发布了成年雄性果蝇完整的脑和中枢神经系统连接组数据集MaleCNS v1.0，随即在社交媒体上引发大量脑洞项目：有人尝试让模拟果蝇脑玩Doom、做加密货币日内交易、玩Balatro，甚至出现了竞品FlyMiner。HashFly本身目前只是一个概念验证，并非真正用生物神经元挖矿，而是把果蝇连接组中的一部分神经元活动模拟搬到网页上。用户可点击“Mine”参与，页面会显示一个缓慢旋转的果蝇脑，神经轨迹不断放电。网页覆盖层显示“2,914条轨迹正在放电”，但这只是完整数据集中165,122个重构神经元的一小部分。

技术实现上，HashFly聚焦于模拟果蝇眼睛中原本负责感光的光感受器。它们读取比特币区块头，当执行双SHA-256目标计算时，名为PPL101的细胞会被“点亮”。用户可上下调整“零”的个数来改变难度。即便在该概念验证的最高难度6级下，其难度也远低于找到真实比特币哈希，实际运行约一小时仅检查了约80个区块。换言之，它没有真实挖矿收益，更多是科学演示和娱乐。

性能对比方面，网页版HashFly的算力约为100 kH/s，而FutureBit自家5英寸立方体矿机Apollo III据称可达最高18 TH/s，两者相差约1.8亿倍。不过FutureBit提出了一个理论上的“趣味事实”：如果这套机制能扩展到真实有机神经元，并按果蝇总功耗计算、假设所有神经元都能持续用于比特币哈希计算，那么其效率可达约1 W/TH，比最好的3nm硅基ASIC高10倍。公司也承认这是基于果蝇总功耗的粗略估算。FutureBit表示，正在进一步模拟数据集中所有神经元执行SHA-256，并会公布全部发现。

意义与影响上，HashFly展示了“有机计算”或“湿件计算”的潜在效率想象，也是Google果蝇连接组开放后工程社区快速将其用于各种模拟的一次典型体现。但目前它离实用化极远：真实挖矿成功率几乎为零，网页演示也无法与ASIC矿机竞争。竞品FlyMiner同样把果蝇连接组置于ASIC矿机控制下，并坦言挖矿成功概率“几乎为零”。这些项目更像是对脑连接组数据、生物计算潜力和加密货币文化的一次跨界戏仿，而非可落地的矿机技术。

history.titleZh: 智能体AI在保持版图等价性的同时实现设计规则自动修复（普渡大学）
history.descriptionZh:
普渡大学研究人员发布技术论文《DRC-Aid: Design-Rule Correction via Agentic Framework utilizing Inference-Time Large Language Models》，提出一种名为 DRC-Aid 的闭环智能体（agentic）框架，利用推理时大语言模型自动修复局部设计规则检查（DRC）违规，并强调在修复过程中保持版图等价。Semiconductor Engineering 对该工作进行了报道。

在芯片物理设计与签核流程中，DRC 用于验证版图是否满足代工厂规定的几何、间距、宽度等制造规则。传统 DRC 修复通常依赖工程师手动修改版图或编写脚本，难点在于几何修复动作的组合空间极大，任何局部改动都可能影响连接关系、寄生参数、时序甚至功能，并且需要反复调用物理验证工具确认，导致迭代周期长、人力成本高。DRC-Aid 的核心思路是把局部 DRC 修复形式化为“验证在环搜索”（verification-in-the-loop search）：智能体提出修复方案，物理验证工具立即检查结果，再将验证反馈用于下一轮搜索，形成闭环迭代，直到违规被消除或达到终止条件。

为控制组合爆炸的几何修复空间，该框架引入确定性的 Rule Engine，将物理验证工具报告的违规信息转换为规则或约束，从而限制大语言模型可生成和采纳的修改范围。这样既发挥了大语言模型在推理、上下文理解和工具调用方面的灵活性，又通过确定性规则引擎降低模型幻觉或无效编辑的风险。论文标题中的“Inference-Time Large Language Models”表明，该方案主要在推理阶段使用大语言模型，而非针对该任务重新训练模型。标题还强调“Preserving Layout Equivalence”，即修复后的版图应与原设计保持等价，通常意味着不改变电路连接、器件关系和功能语义，只进行满足 DRC 所需的局部几何调整。

其创新点可概括为：将智能体 AI、推理时大语言模型、确定性规则引擎和物理验证闭环结合，用于自动化局部 DRC 修复；同时把“修复后必须通过验证且保持版图等价”作为硬约束，而不是仅追求生成看似合理的几何修改。该技术潜在应用于先进节点物理设计、DRC 签核、局部违规自动修复、减少人工迭代以及加速流片周期等场景。

不过，当前公开的摘要片段未披露具体性能参数或对比数据，例如修复成功率、运行时间、面积/功耗/时序影响，以及与商业 EDA 工具或人工修复方法的量化比较。因此无法从现有信息判断其相对传统方法的加速幅度和修复质量，这些结果需查阅完整论文。总体而言，DRC-Aid 代表了将大语言模型智能体引入 EDA 物理验证与修复流程的一种方向：由模型负责搜索和决策，由规则引擎与验证工具负责约束和正确性保证。
